description: A subscription's offers as its store has them, each with its id, type, state (active, draft, scheduled, inactive, ended) and terms. App Store types: intro (the introductory offer, one per country, read as one: the free trial is one too), promotional (code is what the app signs), winback (who it's for under winback), code (offer codes; customers and how many codes were made). Google Play: offers on the base plan, with phases ({ duration, periods, kind: free | discount | price, percent, price }), eligibility (new_app, new_subscription, upgrade, developer), upgradeFrom and tags; trial is true for the free trial the product sets. Prices are US dollars. A Google Play productId is "product:basePlan".

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

name: ploa_offers_get
title: Read a subscription's offers
